description: This source file implements the 'git notes' builtin command for Git, providing functionalities such as listing, adding, copying, editing, showing, merging, removing, pruning, and getting references of notes attached to Git objects. It includes command-line argument parsing, note data management, and integration with Git repositories.

methods.name: void free_note_data(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Releases memory held by a note_msg struct, including freeing comment buffers and the note message array.

methods.name: int list_each_note(const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,char * note_path UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Callback function to list notes associated with objects, printing the note and object OIDs.

methods.name: void copy_obj_to_fd(int fd,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a git object by its OID and writes its content to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void write_commented_object(int fd,const struct object_id * object)
methods.description: Generates and writes a representation of the object with comments including show command output.

methods.name: void prepare_note_data(const struct object_id * object,struct note_data * d,const struct object_id * old_note)
methods.description: Prepares the note data buffer, optionally launching an editor for user editing, and copying existing notes if necessary.

methods.name: void write_note_data(struct note_data * d,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Writes the note buffer as a new git object and updates OID.

methods.name: void append_separator(struct strbuf * message)
methods.description: Appends the separator string to a message buffer if defined.

methods.name: void concat_messages(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple note messages into the main buffer, handling spacing and whitespace stripping according to settings.

methods.name: int parse_msg_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses -m message argument and adds it to the note messages list.

methods.name: int parse_file_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reads note content from a file and adds it to the message list.

methods.name: int parse_reuse_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reads note data from an existing object reference for reuse.

methods.name: int parse_reedit_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets the use_editor flag and reuses note data from an object.

methods.name: int parse_separator_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets the paragraph separator string.

methods.name: int notes_copy_from_stdin(int force,const char * rewrite_cmd)
methods.description: Copies notes between objects based on stdin input, supporting rewrite commands.

methods.name: struct:notes_tree * init_notes_check(const char * subcommand,int flags)
methods.description: Initializes and validates a notes tree with the correct ref prefix for a specific subcommand.

methods.name: int list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists all notes or notes for a specific object.

methods.name: int append_edit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'edit' and 'append' subcommands for notes, allowing addition and modification.

methods.name: int add(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Adds a new note to an object, with options for editing, message, and overwrite.

methods.name: int copy(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Copies notes from a source object to a target object, handling conflicts and overwriting.

methods.name: int show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays the note attached to an object.

methods.name: int merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge, cleaning up refs and worktrees.

methods.name: int merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by creating a commit and updating references.

methods.name: int git_config_get_notes_strategy(const char * key,enum notes_merge_strategy * strategy)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the notes merge strategy from repository config.

methods.name: int merge(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs merging of notes, handling different strategies, conflicts, and commits.

methods.name: int remove_one_note(struct notes_tree * t,const char * name,unsigned flag)
methods.description: Removes a note for a specific object identified by name.

methods.name: int remove_cmd(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'remove' subcommand, removing notes for specified objects or stdin.

methods.name: int prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prunes unused notes with optional verbosity and dry-run.

methods.name: int get_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs the current notes reference.

methods.name: int cmd_notes(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git notes' command, dispatching subcommands based on user input.
